rule: Frozen before first model exposure; numerical evidence bindings are deterministic.

findings.proposition: Flex has the strongest broad development case: higher total-sample appeal and numerically higher purchase intent, with no established purchase-intent advantage over Plus.
findings.claim_boundary: May describe randomised concept-cell differences; do not claim real-market sales impact.

findings.proposition: Plus is more differentiated than the other concepts and its response is more polarised, so top-2-box alone is incomplete.
findings.claim_boundary: Do not equate uniqueness with universal preference or causal conversion.

findings.proposition: Plus performs materially better among the pre-specified food-explorer subgroup, creating a genuine targeted opportunity alongside Flex's broader strength.
findings.claim_boundary: Subgroup membership is observational; concept assignment remains randomised.

findings.proposition: Simple is easy to understand and credible but lacks a sufficiently strong multi-measure case to displace the two more strategically distinctive options.
findings.claim_boundary: Do not call Simple a failure if its absolute ratings are respectable.

findings.proposition: Weighting changes selected top-line estimates enough that weighted results should be treated as primary, without overturning the major concept story.
findings.claim_boundary: Do not turn weighting itself into a management finding.

findings.proposition: Premium-value diagnostics use a routed understanding-qualified universe and must not be compared as though they share the unconditional purchase-intent denominator.
findings.claim_boundary: Methodological qualification only unless routing differences materially alter interpretation.

findings.proposition: Diagnostic associations may explain the pattern descriptively but do not establish that uniqueness, value or ease causes purchase intent.
findings.claim_boundary: No driver/causal language without separately specified modelling assumptions.

findings.proposition: A statistically detectable but sub-5pp difference is not a major commercial finding solely because it is significant.
findings.claim_boundary: Can be mentioned as secondary detail if relevant; must not outrank materially larger findings.

findings.proposition: Unplanned demographic subgroup spikes require exploratory qualification and corroboration before driving the development decision.
findings.claim_boundary: Do not elevate solely on nominal p-value.

findings.proposition: Simple's isolated diagnostic or noisy subgroup strength does not make it the hidden overall winner.
evidence_required: Simple diagnostic strength plus primary outcomes
findings.claim_boundary: Preserve genuine Simple strengths while resisting reversal of the evidence hierarchy.
